nodes.label: deck-anatomy.md (component reference)
nodes.rationale: Copy-paste reference for day-NN.html: every component already exists and works, so a new day means copying from day-01.html at the given line ranges, not authoring markup from scratch.

nodes.label: slides/ file layout
nodes.rationale: day-01.html, assets/ (styles.css, tokens/, components/, icons.css, deck.css, deck.js, brand/, fonts/) and media/. Load order (styles.css:5-14, later wins): tokens, components, icons, deck.css last.

nodes.label: assets/styles.css (the only link)
nodes.rationale: The ONLY stylesheet link in a page; @imports everything else in order.

nodes.label: assets/deck.css (overrides live here)
nodes.rationale: The deck layer plus every project override; edit HERE and never edit components/. Raises the system type defaults (deck.css:333-340). Still holds the dead chatlog CSS.

nodes.label: assets/deck.js (nav, scale, guard, interactions)
nodes.rationale: Navigation, scaling, overflow guard and the interaction layer in one script; see the deck.js contract.

nodes.label: assets/icons.css (Lucide as CSS masks)
nodes.rationale: Vendored as CSS masks, no CDN, works offline.

nodes.label: components/frames.css and elements.css
nodes.rationale: frames.css = slide frames (geometry fixed at frames.css:3-18), elements.css = badge, cards. Never edit; override in deck.css.

nodes.label: tokens/ (fonts, colors, type, spacing, rtl)
nodes.rationale: Token files imported first by styles.css.

nodes.label: media/ (recordings, flat)
nodes.rationale: Referenced as src="media/name.mp4".

nodes.label: Page shell (copy day-01.html:1-16, 3970-3983)
nodes.rationale: Per-day edits are only the <title>, the day label in each footer and the HUD '1 / NN' placeholder. RTL html lang=ar, deck-stage/deck-scaler wrappers, HUD buttons, one script.

nodes.label: Every slide needs sag-slide AND deck-slide
nodes.rationale: sag-slide is the frame, deck-slide is the nav hook. A section missing deck-slide is invisible to navigation, numbering and the audit.

nodes.label: Five slide frame types
nodes.rationale: Geometry fixed by frames.css:3-18: 1920x1080, direction rtl, overflow hidden, flex column, padding 96px 96px 48px.

nodes.label: Cover frame (sag-title, dark)
nodes.rationale: Copy from day-01.html:18-66; data-surface=dark.

nodes.label: Session break / pull-quote (sag-quote)
nodes.rationale: data-tone=rule + data-surface=dark. Footer carries only a badge (no logo, no day label). data-tone: rule = teal mark, warning = amber, omitted = sky.

nodes.label: Media / step-video frame (sag-media)
nodes.rationale: Head differs: title BEFORE badge and no .sag-slide__rule; works because the head is a grid with explicit placement, not source order.

nodes.label: Closing frame (sag-closing, dark)
nodes.rationale: Copy from day-01.html:3899-3967.

nodes.label: Plain content frame (the default)
nodes.rationale: Head (badge, h2 title, rule), body (optional lead, bento, optional footnote card, optional terms template), footer (endorse logo, day label, machine-written page number). Copy from day-01.html:424-487.

nodes.label: Unused, unproven frames
nodes.rationale: .sag-section, .sag-split, .sag-steps and .sag-table exist in CSS but are unused and unproven.

nodes.label: .bento grid
nodes.rationale: The grid every body uses. Only data-cols 2, 3, 4 and data-rows=6 have CSS rules; data-cols=1 works by grid fallback. Span helpers .bento__span-2/-3. Uses align-content: safe center.

nodes.label: .card (the workhorse)
nodes.rationale: Modifiers: card--accent (5px sky start-border), card--state (teal), card--plain (transparent footnote strip); card__num navy pill; card__title--sm 26px; card__note--sm 24px. Block flow, not flex. A warning card has no modifier, only an inline border-inline-start:5px solid var(--state-warning).

nodes.label: .stat
nodes.rationale: stat__v + stat__l; use stat__v--word whenever the value is not a numeral.

nodes.label: .sess (one session column)
nodes.rationale: sess__head (name + duration), optional sess__note, a .tasks list, optional sess__note--foot.

nodes.label: Use sess__note--foot under a task list
nodes.rationale: .sess__note has margin -6px 0 0 to hug its heading; under a task list always use --foot or the negative margin pulls it into the last row.

nodes.label: .task / .tasks live checkboxes
nodes.rationale: Flat sibling rows. data-task-key = cross-slide identity, data-parent = roll-up by key never by DOM nesting, task--l2/l3 indent, tasks--tree 6px gap, task--free dashed, data-done=partial set by JS only. Without a key the row is identified by its .task__t text, so rewording resets saved state. Assumes a light surface.

nodes.label: .stepvid (recording + timed steps)
nodes.rationale: Video first in markup (lands visually RIGHT under RTL) + ordered step list; steps carry data-t and a stepvid__time button. .stepvid__list is a sanctioned scroller. __player and __list are required class names: initStepVideos bails without them.

nodes.label: Amber means the list is right, the recording behind
nodes.rationale: All amber affordances use the same colour on purpose so the trainee learns one rule.

nodes.label: stepvid__step--new
nodes.rationale: For a real action absent from the footage: amber row with مضافة and NO data-t.

nodes.label: stepvid__fix
nodes.rationale: For an on-screen step whose content moved: an amber inset note inside __body (`مو في المقطع:`).

nodes.label: stepvid__mark--idx
nodes.rationale: For a step with no matching video moment: a sky ordinal badge instead of a dead 0:00 button.

nodes.label: stepvid__video--soon + stepvid__soon
nodes.rationale: For a capture that does not exist yet: a dashed placeholder box.

nodes.label: Omit data-t to author a non-video row
nodes.rationale: parseFloat(null) is NaN, which initStepVideos already skips on both click and highlight paths; no JS change needed. Once the footage matches, DELETE the amber note, do not convert it.

nodes.label: initStepVideos()
nodes.rationale: Wires timed steps to the video; bails without .stepvid__player and .stepvid__list; skips steps whose data-t is NaN.

nodes.label: .snipbox (command + copy button)
nodes.rationale: cmd

nodes.label: Bare .snip (output, no wrapper/button)
nodes.rationale: Output the trainee reads and matches against but never copies.

nodes.label: Test: does the step ask to reproduce this string
nodes.rationale: Not length, not how code-like it looks. A single bare word they must find in a longer list is still output. Inline tok-code is only for a passing mention.

nodes.label: Inline tok-code span
nodes.rationale: Reserved for a short passing mention of a name, never a string the step asks the trainee to type or locate.

nodes.label: .promptbox (prepared prompt for Claude)
nodes.rationale: A copy button with data-copy plus a visible paragraph carrying the SAME wording (update both together or they drift). Use wherever a step's point is 'copy this and paste it to Claude'; not a .snipbox (short command) nor a card--plain quote (no copy affordance). Real instances: day-05 slides task-121 and task-121-gap.

nodes.label: Prompt names where data lives, not which task
nodes.rationale: By the time a prompt runs, the data is already in PRODUCT.md (the current state). Pointing at a task number («من رحلتي (11.1)») makes Claude reconstruct from a finished process; point at the section: «القسم 4 في PRODUCT.md». Caught on Day 5: slide 8's extraction prompt shipped with the task-number version.

nodes.label: A numbered-task prompt must OPEN with the task number
nodes.rationale: «طبّق مهمّة 14.5: …». Claude reads the prompt with the whole building-features/SKILL.md available but cannot tell which of its seven task sections is invoked; the number selects the right one (inputs, steps, completion check). Incident: Day 8's 14.5 prompt shipped without it while 14.3's and 14.4's had it.

nodes.label: The two prompt rules compose, not conflict
nodes.rationale: They govern different halves: the leading task number names WHAT to run; body references name WHERE data is. One prompt carries both: «طبّق مهمّة 14.5: … كما وصفتها في رحلتي (القسم 4 في PRODUCT.md)».

nodes.label: Gap and hygiene prompts take no task number
nodes.rationale: Applies to a prompt invoking a numbered task, not every .promptbox: a gap prompt («فكّرت في [شاشة] ما ذكرتها…») or session-hygiene prompt belongs to no task; a number would be a false claim.

nodes.label: Exception: no section exists yet to point at
nodes.rationale: A prompt for the task that first produces a PRODUCT.md section has nothing to reference. 'تعتمد على المهمة 11.1' in task metadata is sequencing information, not an instruction on where to pull data from.

nodes.label: Media frame (image / plain video)
nodes.rationale: sag-media-frame with a box, a video and a caption plus a sag-media__side card. Only instance: day-01.html:2219-2252.

nodes.label: .flow (+ --row) numbered sequence
nodes.rationale: Numbered via CSS counter on a bare <ol>. For ordered steps; .bento reads as parallel facts. Copy: day-01.html:1818-1824, 2082-2087.

nodes.label: .agenda (--break, --main)
nodes.rationale: Day-rhythm rows (day-01.html:174-193).

nodes.label: .idx (data-group)
nodes.rationale: Index cell; .idx__t is one line, ellipsised (733-760).

nodes.label: .pkgtree
nodes.rationale: The package listing (__p, __d, --read, --mute); a sanctioned scroller (1099-1180).

nodes.label: .tmap (29-task table)
nodes.rationale: Lives inside a <template class=terms> and needs data-wide=true; badges __b--decide / review / try (536-711).

nodes.label: .dlbtn download button
nodes.rationale: A real download link styled as a button; must be an <a href> (2232).

nodes.label: .deck-part '1 / 2' marker
nodes.rationale: Inline inside the <h2> (907).

nodes.label: .sag-slide__lead--wide
nodes.rationale: Lifts the 34ch cap on that slide only; for a definition, not a hook.

nodes.label: .sag-slide__title--note
nodes.rationale: Inline commentary span inside the <h2> (1094).

nodes.label: .kbd keycap
nodes.rationale: Light background, not for dark slides (1964).

nodes.label: Interaction layer: three affordances, one engine
nodes.rationale: Choose: one short clause on a phrase -> .ttip[data-tip]; one short definition on a term/acronym -> .ttip--icon; a paragraph or several related terms -> .qmark + <template class=terms>.

nodes.label: Legend slide (data-anchor=legend)
nodes.rationale: Teaches the affordances to trainees with live demos; add any new affordance there too or nobody will find it.

nodes.label: .ttip[data-tip]
nodes.rationale: One short clause on a phrase.

nodes.label: .ttip--icon (term / acronym)
nodes.rationale: Needs data-tip-title and data-tip. .i is a CSS mask and renders nothing but the mask, so anything nested inside an .i is invisible: the entire reason .ttip--icon exists as a wrapper.

nodes.label: .qmark + terms template
nodes.rationale: <button class=qmark type=button data-term=...>؟</button> opens a panel from the slide's <template class=terms>. The ؟ is a literal Arabic character, not an icon (icons.css has none, and a mirrored Latin ? is wrong in RTL).

nodes.label: <template class=terms>
nodes.rationale: One per slide, anywhere inside the section. Opening any ؟ renders ALL that slide's terms with the clicked one highlighted (suppressed when only one). data-wide=true widens to 1320px for a table. Inner HTML injected verbatim.

nodes.label: qmark button holds only the ؟ glyph
nodes.rationale: <button class=qmark>مكوّنات؟</button> renders the whole word inside the small circular badge and collides with the text below. The word stays plain text immediately before the button. Caught only by screenshot since deckAudit checks overflow, not malformed components; grep each new qmark for more than one character.

nodes.label: A reusable .qmark is often the right fix
nodes.rationale: A plain-language ask like 'an icon that explains RTL and LTR' describes an interaction (click a marker, see a definition) that .qmark + terms template already does. Check it before inventing a second mechanism.

nodes.label: data-ref deep link + section name
nodes.rationale: On a .task, .reflink or card. deck.js resolves it against this deck and builds the tooltip from the target slide's own badge, so a rename cannot desync it. Resolution order: data-anchor equals ref; badge number equals ref; badge label contains ref. First match wins, so two slides sharing a badge number both resolve to the earlier: give the later a data-anchor. Anchor names may be Arabic. Ctrl/Cmd+click jumps, Backspace returns.

nodes.label: .reflink live cross-reference
nodes.rationale: Any cross-reference to another slide is a live reflink, never prose; «بعد البند 5» is a defect.

nodes.label: data-ref cannot cross day files
nodes.rationale: resolveRef searches only the current document. A Day-2 slide cannot link to Day 1's mvp-scope; anything a later day needs must be restated briefly in that day's own deck.

nodes.label: window.deckRefAudit()
nodes.rationale: Returns unresolved data-ref values and fails loudly on a dead ref; also proves no ref points at a Day-1 anchor missing from this file.

nodes.label: Closed set of 22 icons
nodes.rationale: i-alert-triangle, book-open, calendar, check, circle-check, clock, cloud-upload, copy, database, download, file-text, git-branch, info, layers, lightbulb, list-checks, palette, rocket, shield-check, terminal, users, wrench. There is no question-mark icon and no dash icon (the partial-task dash is an inline --i override in deck.css).

nodes.label: Design tokens (semantic aliases)
nodes.rationale: Colour tokens are semantic aliases over a 7-colour palette. Reference the alias, never raw --brand-*, or a dark slide will not flip.

nodes.label: Sky = structure, teal = state only
nodes.rationale: --accent-structure (sky) is for rules, buttons, technical accents; --accent-state (teal) is for active/done/progress only.

nodes.label: Effective type scale
nodes.rationale: After deck.css:333-340 raises defaults: --fs-display 76px, --fs-slide-title 46, --fs-body-lead 33, --fs-body 26, --fs-caption 24, --fs-mono 20.

nodes.label: Never override a font size downward to fit
nodes.rationale: Split the slide instead; the floor may only ever be raised.

nodes.label: Spacing, radii, elevation tokens
nodes.rationale: --sp-1..8 = 8/16/24/32/48/64/96/128; --radius-sm|md|lg|pill = 8/14/24/999; max elevation 2px (--lift-1, --lift-2, --lift-2-dark); border --border-hairline.

nodes.label: data-surface=dark remaps tokens
nodes.rationale: Remaps --surface-slide, --surface-card (#1B2E56), --surface-card-line, --text-heading (white), --text-body, --text-caption, --text-link, --rule-hairline.

nodes.label: --deck-scale and --tip-dx runtime vars
nodes.rationale: Set by JS: --deck-scale on <html>, --tip-dx on each .tip.

nodes.label: deck.js contract
nodes.rationale: Exports and behaviours the deck depends on: audits, navigation keys, footer numbering, task state, HUD (idle-hides after 2s so it never covers content), init order.

nodes.label: window.deckAudit()
nodes.rationale: Logs and returns the overflowing slide numbers. THE gate: nothing is done until it prints 'N slides, none overflow'. Measures border boxes and skips inline boxes.

nodes.label: Navigation keys (RTL)
nodes.rationale: Arrow/Space/PageUp/PageDown navigate (RTL: ArrowLeft advances); Home/End/F/H = first/last/fullscreen/hide HUD; Backspace undoes the last deep-link jump.

nodes.label: Task state in localStorage per day file
nodes.rationale: Key sag-deck:<filename>:tasks, namespaced per day file so keys never collide across days.

nodes.label: Init order is deliberate
nodes.rationale: initGifs, initRefs, initTips, initQmarks, initTasks, initCopyButtons, initStepVideos. initRefs runs BEFORE initTasks so a task row's Ctrl-check is bound ahead of its checkbox toggle.

nodes.label: initGifs()
nodes.rationale: First step of the init sequence.

nodes.label: initRefs()
nodes.rationale: Resolves data-ref values; must run before initTasks.

nodes.label: initTips()
nodes.rationale: Wires .ttip tooltips.

nodes.label: initQmarks()
nodes.rationale: Wires .qmark term windows.

nodes.label: initTasks()
nodes.rationale: Builds byKey / childrenOf / parentOf over KEYS, not elements, which makes one key repaint on every slide it appears on. Parent states true / 'partial' / false are recomputed from children at load rather than trusted from storage.

nodes.label: initCopyButtons()
nodes.rationale: Handles .snipbox__copy and .promptbox__copy; relies on the execCommand fallback because navigator.clipboard rejects under file://.

nodes.label: Traps that have actually bitten
nodes.rationale: Three groups: layout and measurement, markup that silently breaks, environment.

nodes.label: transform: scale() does not shrink layout box
nodes.rationale: getBoundingClientRect is scaled device px; divide by --deck-scale before comparing to a CSS px value.

nodes.label: Guard measures border boxes, skips inline
nodes.rationale: Cairo's glyph box is taller than its em, so scrollHeight > clientHeight on any heading even when nothing is clipped (ink bleed). Do not 'fix' the guard to use scrollHeight.

nodes.label: Do not hand-roll an overflow diagnostic
nodes.rationale: One ad-hoc script blamed .tip overlays for 52px when the real culprit was a card__note 2.9px over: it failed to replicate boxOverflow's rejection of absolutely-positioned subtrees. Run deckAudit() or copy the walker faithfully.

nodes.label: align-content: safe center, safe is load-bearing
nodes.rationale: Plain center overflows equally in both directions, pushing content out through the top where trimming below can never recover it.

nodes.label: .card must not be a flex column
nodes.rationale: Margins do not collapse in flex, so every extra .card__note cost the gap plus ~18px above plus ~18px below.

nodes.label: .card > * does not reach grandchildren
nodes.rationale: An <h3> inside .card__top kept its UA margin 1em 0: 41 dead px in every card in the deck until zeroed.

nodes.label: Horizontal overflow is a separate check
nodes.rationale: deckAudit does not cover it; watch .snip boxes and step lists, including inside ؟ windows.

nodes.label: overflow-wrap: anywhere, not break-word
nodes.rationale: Only 'anywhere' shrinks min-content so a box can actually contract around long tokens.

nodes.label: A real <video> inflates its box
nodes.rationale: Force it absolute inside .sag-media-frame__box.

nodes.label: Reclaim space before cutting words
nodes.rationale: Grid gap, card padding, component chrome first; putting the badge and title on one row gave back ~74px on every slide.

nodes.label: Fill width with type size, not a stretched column
nodes.rationale: A minmax(0,1fr) description column only moves the emptiness to one side; 58% fill at 34px became 94% at 37/38px.

nodes.label: Footer number is machine-written
nodes.rationale: Written to .deck-foot > .deck-foot__num (direct child only). Never hand-maintain page numbers; keep the day label nested inside .deck-foot__side or it gets clobbered.

nodes.label: .sag-slide__head is a grid with hard-coded placement
nodes.rationale: Badge row 1 col 1, title row 1 col 2, rule and lead row 2; a third element dropped directly in the head lands in an unplaced auto row.

nodes.label: A tooltip host must be position: relative
nodes.rationale: Otherwise bottom: calc(100% + 10px) resolves against the slide and the tip lands 1090px up, in the DOM but invisible.

nodes.label: .snipbox__copy must be a sibling of the <pre>
nodes.rationale: As a child, its icon glyph is copied along with the command. It floats on hover so it reserves no space.

nodes.label: .snip and .kbd have hard-coded light backgrounds
nodes.rationale: Do not put them on a dark slide.

nodes.label: .qmark must be <button type=button>
nodes.rationale: Inside a task row it relies on stopPropagation to avoid ticking the row.

nodes.label: A duplicated data-task-key couples unrelated rows
nodes.rationale: Silent; two different tasks start ticking together.

nodes.label: Grep class values for non-ASCII after hand edits
nodes.rationale: deck-foot__num once became deك-foot__num and would have silently lost its styling.

nodes.label: Test over file://, not http://localhost
nodes.rationale: Python's http.server has no Range support, so video seeking appears broken when it is fine. The real presentation is always file://.

nodes.label: navigator.clipboard rejects under file://
nodes.rationale: Silently; the execCommand fallback is mandatory. Do not 'modernise' it away.

nodes.label: Scope verification queries to the active slide
nodes.rationale: A global selector once returned a tooltip from a different slide entirely.

nodes.label: A CSS comment can swallow the rules after it
nodes.rationale: Prose accidentally placed after */ silently killed three rules; the symptom was a value reverting with no diff to explain it.

hyperedges.label: stepvid amber-state variants (list right, clip behind)
